title: Inventory boundary
subtitle: The subsidiaries, sites, categories and named sources a year's inventory covers
readOnly: Only a super admin can declare, confirm or delete a boundary. You can view it.
grantedView: You see only the subsidiaries you have access to; any other subsidiary this version declares is not shown.
openExists: Version {version} is open. Edit it, or delete it, before you start another.

versions.title: Versions for {year}
versions.label: Version {version}
versions.empty: No boundary has been declared for {year}. Start a version to declare one.
versions.emptyReader: No boundary you can read has been declared for {year}.
versions.failed: The versions could not be loaded.

stateNote.open: Open: it can be edited, then confirmed or deleted. A report captured from it freezes it without confirming it.
stateNote.confirmed: Confirmed and frozen: it takes no change. New facts need a new version.
stateNote.frozenUnconfirmed: Frozen by a report capture without being confirmed: it takes no change and cannot be confirmed. Start a new version from it to confirm.

toast.savedWithGaps: Gaps to resolve before the version can be confirmed: {count}
toast.frozenElsewhere: This version was frozen in the meantime; it takes no change.
toast.changedElsewhere: {name} was changed by someone else after you opened it. Open it again and make your change.
toast.versionChanged: Version {version} was changed by someone else while you looked at it. Review it again before you confirm.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm version {version}?
confirmDialog.body: Confirming freezes the version for good: it can no longer be edited or deleted, and a final report can be issued from it.
confirmDialog.undeclared: Not declared, so outside the inventory: {names}
confirmDialog.blockedEmpty: Declare at least one subsidiary first.

deleteDialog.title: Delete version {version}?
deleteDialog.body: The open version and every declaration in it are deleted. This cannot be undone.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.body: {name}'s declaration is removed from this version.

editor.title: {name} — version {version}
editor.description: The months, sites, categories and named sources this subsidiary's inventory covers.
editor.sitesHint: A declared site is an entity of the inventory. Removing one removes its decisions and sources.
editor.categoriesHint: For each category, choose whether it is attributed to the company or to its sites and how often it is reported, then decide for each entity whether it is included.
editor.sourcesHint: A meter, invoice or asset the inventory counts or names as excluded. An included source needs its category's attribution first.
editor.unsupportedReason: Why it maps to no category
editor.unsupportedReasonFor: Why source {n} maps to no category

issues.cadenceRequired: Choose how often it is reported.
